verdict.rationale: The standalone Tax API explicitly supports 'handling reversals directly' alongside calculating and recording transactions, implying refund/credit-note tax adjustments are possible, and Stripe Tax reports/TaxJar filing integration exist. But there is no direct documentation or community evidence confirming that negative amounts from refunds/credit notes automatically flow through liability reports and the next TaxJar filing without manual correction. missing for 10: explicit docs on refund/credit-note tax reversal flowing into reports and filings, and independent confirmation that no manual journal fixes are needed.
